description:
Update an existing Operator's community registry entry.

Requires the same two proofs as ``register_operator``:

- ``proof`` proves the caller controls the Operator's ``npub``.
- ``authority_proof`` proves the Authority's human admin consents
  to the change. Without the Authority proof, anyone with the
  Operator's nsec could redirect their own ``service_url`` under
  this Authority's signature without the Authority's awareness.

authority_proof.description: Identity proof signed by the Authority's OWN npub — the Authority's consent to modify this Operator's registry entry.

display_name.description: New display name (leave empty to keep current).

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: Nostr npub of the Operator to update.

service_url.description: New MCP endpoint URL (leave empty to keep current).

name: authority_update_operator
title: Update operator
